aboutBody: LP/EP Finder is a free search engine for vinyl records sold by independent record shops. It started more than ten years ago, and was called Vinyl Finder for a while.

Every day our crawler, LPEPFinderBot, reads the public product catalogs of record shops, keeps the records in stock, and builds a search index. We link to the shop for every record; we don't sell anything and don't copy product descriptions or images.

Shop owners: your shop is listed for free. LPEPFinderBot reads your public catalog once a day, one request at a time, at most one a second (slower if your robots.txt sets a Crawl-delay); most shops get a dozen requests a day. To slow it down, set a Crawl-delay; to be removed, block LPEPFinderBot in robots.txt or open an issue on GitHub; to be added, use the form on the “Add a shop” page.
aboutData: Shop list from the LP/EP Finder community, Discogs record store listings and OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Product data from each shop's public catalog. Artist profiles from MusicBrainz, Wikidata, Wikipedia and Wikimedia Commons, credited on each page.

statusBody: Every shop is checked daily: is the site up, does robots.txt allow us, does it still sell records, can we read its catalog.

privacyBody: LP/EP Finder does not ask for an account and does not store personal data on its servers. Searches run in your browser.

Advertising: this site shows ads from Google AdSense. Google and its partners use cookies to show ads based on your visits to this and other websites. You can turn off personalised ads in Google's Ads Settings (adssettings.google.com). Visitors in the European Economic Area, the UK and Switzerland are asked for consent first.
Analytics: we count visits with Umami, which uses no cookies and collects no personal data. The statistics are public.

Your list (the records you watch, your Discogs lists, your radio) stays in your browser; nothing is kept on our servers. Your Discogs lists and your Radio4000 radio are read by your browser from Discogs and Radio4000. Artist photos load from Wikimedia Commons. A YouTube video loads from youtube-nocookie.com only when you tap Play.
Links to record shops take you to their websites, which have their own privacy policies.
Questions, corrections or removal requests: open an issue on GitHub.
